context: The party has found a small shrine/grotto in a goblin camp containing a statue of Selûne with a bronze plaque written in an ancient, dead tongue. Shadowheart recognises the moon goddess and reacts with thinly veiled disdain—she’s perturbed by the statue’s presence and inclined to mock or demean it because Selûne is a rival to her patron (Shar); if Shadowheart’s faith hasn’t been revealed to the party yet, her comments will be more reserved. The player reads the plaque but can’t decipher the dead language and therefore remarks that whatever worshippers kept this place are likely long gone. The statue’s appearance is deliberately incongruous among marauding goblins and, in Shadowheart’s view, merits an ignominious fate.
